procedures.instruction: Use OperatingSession to compose existing episode evidence, qualified capabilities and explicit owner choices. Retain exact guide/depth/section and source/pose/side relationships during construction. Automatically feed fresh scoped findings into the next decision; a no-op in one region or a worse scalar metric does not judge the whole candidate. The owner records actual matched-image interpretation against the exact result; technical execution, save/reopen, user acceptance and method benefit remain separate. Preserve original receipts and reuse unchanged evidence. Recover known returned effects without replay. Keep budgets, generation job authority and one native owner unchanged. For repeated section/material fitting and candidate follow-up, use guide_fitting and CandidatePipeline through this same session. Preserve explicit interpolation ancestry and displacement coordinates, build follow-ups from actual outputs, and record the owner's real interventions alongside native runtime.

conditions.observed_failure: construction score improves but ridges persist, pose triangulation differs, dependent geometry moves with fixed anchors, support formula disagrees with saved native samples, or plane sections show gaps

procedures.instruction: Read the packaged construction-diagnostics reference. Compare local bend tails and spatial concentration alongside the global objective. Validate each measured pose's recorded triangle layout before claiming an exact native comparison; explicitly label a deliberately fixed chart. For attached parts, reproduce the baseline from independent anchors, support frames and offsets, then distinguish expected motion from unexplained residuals. Fixed anchors do not imply fixed frames, and exact cell freezing is an experiment constraint, not a universal rule. Reproduce the complete saved support calculation, including saturated/additive branches, before interpreting target displacement. Preserve preview-border and coplanar exclusions. Multiple changed mechanisms do not isolate causal benefit. Verify selected package/procedure bytes; these diagnostics neither relax exact transaction checks nor establish native or appearance adoption.
source_queries: construction curvature ridge chart transition support formula native reproduction saturated margin plane section vertex gap causal confound
per pose triangulation quad diagonal fixed chart attachment anchor support frame expected motion unexplained residual
limits: Sampled offline diagnostics only
No target admission, native repair, causal proof or appearance acceptance

conditions.observed_failure: target changed or accurate native prediction still fails connected shape

procedures.instruction: Use inspect_control_coverage to distinguish complete forward influence from complete reverse target ancestry. Recover a full declared control universe, preserve protected and provisional exclusion reasons, and inspect omitted paths before repeating a fit. Structural ancestry does not prove a useful coupled response, feasible protected fit or good appearance.
source_queries: reverse target ancestry inherited control family native prediction crease fit coverage
limits: Offline structural diagnostic; no native mutation
A restricted matrix cannot establish exhaustive ancestry
No automatic relaxation of protection or generation request

procedures.instruction: Preserve the exact stopped candidate and distinguish termination status, independently measured constraint feasibility and stationarity. A line-search or convergence stop alone does not establish impossible geometry, missing guide shape or a need for generation. When the problem supports it, test numerical rescaling of the unchanged objective and constraints in a separate bounded trial, compare actual geometry change, and retain all statuses.
source_queries: solver termination feasibility stationarity unchanged constraints objective scaling
limits: A bounded diagnostic rule, not automatic optimizer recovery
Do not change constraints or clamp geometry to relabel a numerical stop
Stationarity tests require a justified model and appropriate residuals; they do not prove global optimality or shape quality
Native writeback, triangle support, motion and appearance remain separate evidence

procedures.instruction: Retain a narrowly demonstrated method gain at any modeling phase without waiting for whole-character success. Preserve exact executable inputs, protected context, artistic variables, qualified support/exclusions and failed alternatives. Close an episode with an implemented procedure/tool/rule, bounded experimental recipe, or explicit not-generalizable result. Retrieve by mechanism and verify actual use; distinguish source, installed, runtime and operator adoption.
source_queries: supported diagnostic method integration mechanism applicability counterexamples actual use
limits: Character and method judgments stay separate
Local retention does not prove live adoption or cross-character quality
Saving and recovery never wait for integration prose

procedures.instruction: The inspected screenshot supplies view/crop/pose; accepted artwork supplies likeness and intended anatomy. Review recognizable source before reconstructing unknown depth. Geometric support is qualified after delivery, before fitting.
source_queries: The inspected screenshot supplies view/crop/pose; accepted artwork supplies likeness and intended anatomy. Review recognizable source before reconstructing unknown depth. Geometric support is qualified after delivery, before fitting.
limits: A useful source is not a qualified 3D target

procedures.instruction: For observed omission of support, make complete connected foreground skin explicit. Inspect actual connected skin and its depth; exclude unsupported lash/shadow relief and artificial borders/back geometry. This is not a universal ban on crops.

procedures.instruction: Qualify useful connected interior skin separately from incised margin, ripples, artificial shell/back/brow/lash/perimeter. Generated extras alone do not reject useful interior support. Use actual matched sections, registration and ocular relationships, retaining exclusions and source-review limitations.

procedures.instruction: Reread workspace policy, source review and actual live panel before claim. A scoped exception remains source/experiment bound. Preserve one durable job; reconcile uncertainty and actual exported output identity before another submission. Requested topology and actual geometry remain separate facts.

procedures.instruction: Load actual feature bindings and require guide/depth/corresponding-section constraints DURING every correction, including smoothing. Check whole head and enlarged feature joins/corners, multiple angles and relevant guide poses/in-betweens. Keep provisional restrictions separate from user obligations.

limits: Improved local metrics do not imply appearance acceptance
Finite motion checks do not prove every continuous pose

procedures.instruction: Preserve and save retained native work immediately with the preceding checkpoint. Consequential retention needs independent native reopen. A saved result may carry pending causal/artistic judgment; reconcile the same trial rather than repeating an uncertain mutation.

limits: Local retention and user appearance acceptance remain independent

procedures.instruction: Record static rejection independently of native rollback and saved/applied status. Existing rollback_trial requires the exact after.expected_state; review-only pose or view changes can invalidate that broad token. Do not reset review state or relax the guard. The sole native owner may use a new guarded transaction from freshly verified actual working state toward an explicitly authorized comparison baseline, retaining actual-before plus comparison arrays and both trial histories. This is an available continuation pattern, not automatic rollback or evidence of candidate retention.
